debugData.name: Macro noise (shared, tileable)
debugData.description: Four tileable noises for a terrain material's large-scale variation: R a broad fbm (brightness), G a second fbm (hue or roughness), B soft-edged patches (masks), A a blue-ish noise (dithering). Linear data, UASTC without RDO. The toolkit's bakeMacroNoise() with its defaults (512², seed 0), exported on WebGPU from the noiseLibrary scene's tab (exportBakedTexture, p304 D4-D5): the same texture without a bake at load.
